description: This source file implements the PdfEncryptionV1To4 class, which manages encryption versions 1, 2, and 4 for PDF security handling, including methods for setting encryption types, initializing from loaded security handlers, password validation, and object encryption/decryption using RC4 and AES algorithms.

classes.name: PdfEncryptionV1To4
classes.description: Handles PDF encryption versions 1, 2, and 4, providing methods for setting encryption types, validation, and object encryption/decryption.

methods.name: SetEncryptionToV1
methods.description: Configures encryption to version 1 with RC4 and 40-bit key.

methods.name: SetEncryptionToV2
methods.description: Configures encryption to version 2 with RC4 and specified key length (default 40 bits).

methods.name: SetEncryptionToV4UsingRC4
methods.description: Configures encryption to version 4 using RC4 with 128-bit key.

methods.name: SetEncryptionToV4UsingAES
methods.description: Configures encryption to version 4 using AES with 128-bit key.

methods.name: InitializeFromLoadedSecurityHandler
methods.description: Initializes encryption parameters from a loaded security handler.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets internal encryption version, length, and metadata encryption flag.

methods.name: GetDefaultLength
methods.description: Returns default key length based on version.

methods.name: CheckVersionAndLength
methods.description: Validates version and key length parameters.

methods.name: IsVersionSupported
methods.description: Checks if a version is supported (1, 2, 4).

methods.name: EnsureIsAESSupported
methods.description: Ensures AES encryption is supported for current version.

methods.name: PrepareEncryptionForSaving
methods.description: Prepares encryption dictionary entries for saving, including passwords and permissions.

methods.name: CalculateRevisionValue
methods.description: Calculates revision number based on version and permissions.

methods.name: PadPassword
methods.description: Pads a password to 32 bytes with Adobe password padding.

methods.name: ComputeOwnerAndUserValues
methods.description: Computes owner and user password values for encryption.

methods.name: ComputeOwnerValue
methods.description: Computes the owner password value using RC4 and hashing.

methods.name: ComputeUserValue
methods.description: Computes the user password value and encryption key.

methods.name: ComputeUserValueByEncryptionKey
methods.description: Generates user value using the encryption key.

methods.name: ComputeAndStoreEncryptionKey
methods.description: Computes and stores the global encryption key based on password, owner, permissions, and document ID.

methods.name: ValidatePassword
methods.description: Validates input password against stored values, checking owner and user passwords.

methods.name: ValidateUserPassword
methods.description: Checks if input password matches the user password.

methods.name: ValidateOwnerPassword
methods.description: Checks if input password matches the owner password.

methods.name: EqualsPasswordValue
methods.description: Compares two password hash values for equality.

methods.name: EnterObject
methods.description: Sets current object ID for encryption/decryption context.

methods.name: LeaveObject
methods.description: Clears current object ID and encryption keys.

methods.name: EncryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Encrypts bytes for the current object using RC4.

methods.name: DecryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Decrypts bytes for the current object using RC4.

methods.name: EncryptForEnteredObjectUsingRC4
methods.description: Performs RC4 encryption on object bytes.

methods.name: DecryptForEnteredObjectUsingRC4
methods.description: Performs RC4 decryption on object bytes.

methods.name: EncryptForEnteredObjectUsingAES
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on object bytes, prepending IV.

methods.name: DecryptForEnteredObjectUsingAES
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on object bytes, extracting IV.

methods.name: ComputeObjectEncryptionKey
methods.description: Computes encryption key for a specific object, using MD5 and optional AES padding.
